title_zh: 选定浅蓝色窗帘布样品

scenario.goal_zh: 比较窗帘的材质、透光性和颜色后选定样品。

context_zh: 阿米娜在家居店比较窗帘样品，工作人员帮助她判断透光效果。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: This dark fabric looks elegant, but will it make my small room feel even darker?

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: Probably. Hold the pale blue sample up to the window and compare them.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: Oh, that looks fabulous in daylight. I can still see the light through it.

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: It softens the light without blocking it completely. Do you want the blue sample to take home?

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: Yes, please. I will check it beside the sofa before ordering the curtains.

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: Here you are. The material and colour numbers are on the back.
